payload.description:
## Context
The owner reports a pale blue background behind typed input. The earlier term-iej94y investigation distinguished ANSI slot 8 from application RGB backgrounds and left the active-client cause unproven. The owner can provide a screenshot later. Preserve active sessions and renderer workarounds.
payload.title: Diagnose the pale Codex input background before changing shared colors

payload.text: Screenshot and read-only Herdr pane SGR analysis confirm that the visible history prompt band is emitted as RGB 68,68,68 (48;2;68;68;68), rather than ANSI palette slot 8. Pixel sample agrees. Installed Codex 0.169.0 and Herdr 0.9.5 both advertise truecolor. Testing a machine-local text_background_opacity preference and neutral foreground brightness, preserving Software rendering and the shared ANSI palette. Verified option against the installed WezTerm 20240203 CLI and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wezterm/wezterm/20240203-110809-5046fc22/docs/config/appearance.md . No input or signals were sent to active panes.

payload.text: [session handover 2026-11-14] [new facts] Implemented measured Windows/WSL prompt fixes and preserved local WezTerm/Starship preferences. Owner selected an optional navy Tokyo Night-inspired preset; shared Software and Kitty defaults remain unchanged. Screenshot/pane SGR shows an RGB 68,68,68 history fill, so ANSI palette edits would not fix it. Local cell-background opacity is 0.20 with neutral foreground brightness. Visual subjective acceptance is not claimed. WSL 748 tests passed; native Windows 721 passed with 27 platform skips; six repository checks passed. Windows full validation exposed two existing test assumptions (UTF-8 CLI output and mocked Herdr discovery), fixed without weakening checks. A first cross-OS test invocation reused the Windows venv; WSL validation was rerun with UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT isolated, and the Windows locked environment was reinstalled at identical versions and its six checks passed. Added contributor instructions for environment separation. No active pane input, terminal restart or WSL shutdown occurred during repository work. Package archives were tested outside the checkout on both systems. Remaining: commit and publish the tested branch; local appearance can be tuned in preserved override files.
